topic: An explanation of NBA players throwing the ball off opponents to keep possession, featuring a funny technical foul incident.

hook.first_words: When a player is falling out of bounds
hook.first_frame: Donovan Mitchell #45 in mid-air holding a basketball near Jalen Brunson.
hook.on_screen_text_0_3s: When a player is falling out of bounds, they usually throw it off an opponent to keep possession.

script: When a player is falling out of bounds, they usually throw it off an opponent to keep possession. Like when LeBron is in this situation, he goes full power to make sure the ball goes out of play. And this creates some funny moments because the players can't really avoid it. But I think what's even funnier is when Desmond Bane did it. You see, OG Anunoby is already out of bounds and Desmond Bane isn't close to losing his balance. However, he still throws the ball at OG and he receives a technical foul for it.
what_makes_it_work: Establishes a common basketball rule/tactic first before introducing an absurd, funny violation.
Uses high-profile highlights of stars like LeBron James to build initial visual interest.
Provides multiple camera angles of the climax moment to maximize humor and clarity.
